# Pow3 / 爆三 Pow3－寶石挖礦

> Dig down, one level at a time. Matches beside the rock break it.

往下挖，一關一關挖。在岩層旁消除，就能打穿岩層。

- iOS 18.0+ · v2.0.0 · 2026-11-25 · 20.6 MB
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1044069059?pt=102436810&ct=llms_pow3&mt=8)
- [Support](https://agentmesh.uk/pow3/support.html)

## FAQ

### Is there a different kind of match-3 game?
Pow3 is gem swapping in a mine shaft: matches crack the rock beside them and a cleared row sinks you one metre, each level with its own digging goal and fixed moves; after level 6 an endless mine ranks you by depth. It plays offline with no sign-up.

### 有沒有不一樣的三消遊戲？
爆三 Pow3 是在礦坑裡交換寶石的三消：消除會敲裂旁邊的岩石，整排打通就往下沉一公尺，每關有自己的挖掘目標和固定步數；過了第 6 關還有只比深度的無盡礦坑。離線也能玩，不用註冊。

### How do you play Pow3?
Swap gems in a mine shaft: a match of three cracks the rock beside it, and clearing a whole row sinks you one metre. Each level has its own goal and a fixed number of moves, such as digging a set depth, freeing gold or breaking the rock core.

### 爆三怎麼玩？
在礦坑裡交換寶石，連成三顆消除就會敲裂旁邊的岩石；整排岩石打通就往下沉一公尺。每關有自己的目標和固定步數，例如挖穿指定深度、敲出金礦或擊碎岩核。

### Can Pow3 be played offline, and is there an endless mode?
Yes, it plays offline with no sign-up, on iPhone and iPad. After level 6 the Endless Mine opens: no levels, only depth, plus daily and weekly challenges.

### 爆三可以離線玩嗎？有無盡模式嗎？
可以離線玩，不用註冊，支援 iPhone 和 iPad。過了第 6 關會開啟無盡礦坑，沒有關卡、只比深度，還有每日與每週挑戰。

### Does Pow3 cost money?
Pow3 is free to download and play; one purchase removes banner and full-screen ads, and rewarded videos stay optional.

### 爆三要付費嗎？
爆三可免費下載遊玩；一次購買即可移除橫幅與全螢幕廣告，獎勵影片仍可自選觀看。
